Five merged pull requests since 2026-04-16 added or removed a line containing `voidedValue` under `src`, all on the main line below the pinned head. The head I used is the v5.0.0 release commit `8f4fd2677aae1d8a8c522f710059b0f26b22d4bb` (2026-10-15), since that is the default branch tip. I took merge dates from each squash commit's date on main.

1. **#842** (O3-5847, "Stop unchanged obs values from creating duplicate obs"), merged 2026-10-13. It adds a new `describe` block to the obs adapter tests with `voidedValue` assertions. @file:{github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib::src/adapters/obs-adapter.test.ts:1566-1581}
2. **#826** (O3-6027, "Clear order and diagnosis submissions on every write"), merged 2026-10-05. It changes `expect(field.meta.submission.voidedValue).toBe(undefined)` to `.toBeNull()`. @file:{github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib::src/adapters/encounter-diagnosis-adapter.test.ts:206}
3. **#822** (O3-6030, "Keep hidden obs group members, orders and diagnoses out of submissions"), merged 2026-10-02. It rewrites the `voidedValue` lines in the order and diagnosis payload preparation. @file:{github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib::src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.ts:297-298}, @file:{github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib::src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.ts:436-437}
4. **#812** ("Add tests to cover form submission orchestration"), merged 2026-09-22. It adds the `submission: { newValue, voidedValue: null }` test helper. @file:{github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib::src/processors/encounter/encounter-form-processor.test.ts:34}
5. **#787** ("Add golden schemas for encounter payloads"), merged 2026-08-20. It creates the golden test file and the `withSubmission` helper that takes `voidedValue`. @file:{github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib::src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.test.ts:39-41}, @file:{github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib::src/processors/encounter/encounter-payloads.golden.test.ts:551}

Checked and excluded: #838, #843, #756, #783, #742 (the jest-to-vitest migration only renamed mocks and imports), and commit `12c24b6` (a direct commit with no PR number). The file-level history for every `src` file that currently contains `voidedValue` was checked, but a file deleted since 2026-04-16 would not be covered.

I could not read the saved full diffs for #787 and #812 directly, so for those two I relied on path-filtered diffs.
